mapper.sql: t.task_id AS taskId, t.title, t.creator_id AS creatorId, c.nickname AS creatorNickname, t.status AS status, t.completion_mode AS completionMode, t.start_time AS startTime, t.deadline AS deadline, t.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(p.participantCount, 0) AS participantCount, COALESCE(p.acceptedCount, 0) AS acceptedCount, COALESCE(p.completedCount, 0) AS completedCount, CASE WHEN t.status IN (1, 2) AND t.deadline < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdueFlag

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS participantCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount FROM t_task_participant WHERE deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY task_id ) p ON p.task_id = t.task_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , c.avatar AS creatorAvatar, t.description, t.images, t.start_notify_flag AS startNotifyFlag, t.remind_minutes AS remindMinutes, t.edit_count AS editCount, t.update_time AS updateTime FROM t_task t INNER JOIN t_wx_member c ON c.member_id = t.creator_id
WHERE t.deleted_flag = 0 AND t.task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT p.participant_id AS participantId, p.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname, m.avatar, p.status AS status, p.complete_time AS completeTime, p.complete_remark AS completeRemark, p.complete_images AS completeImages, p.reject_reason AS rejectReason, CASE WHEN p.complete_time IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN p.complete_time <= t.deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS onTimeFlag FROM t_task_participant p INNER JOIN t_task t ON t.task_id = p.task_id LEFT JOIN t_wx_member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.deleted_flag = 0 AND p.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY p.participant_id ASC

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId, e.event_type AS eventType, e.content, e.actor_id AS actorId, m.nickname AS actorNickname, e.create_time AS createTime FROM t_task_event e LEFT JOIN t_wx_member m ON m.member_id = e.actor_id WHERE e.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY e.event_id ASC
